astar_observation_access: shared observed world maps + perfect self and teammate pose/velocity; NO hidden goal/true obstacles
evaluation: same environment config, seed, 300-step max, independent online rollout; no early stopping at goal or coverage60
time_reached: conditional on reaching; also report censored max_cycles+1

timing.joint_step: one complete A/B team action round; a partially completed terminal round counts as one
timing.runtime_sec: wall clock from start of env.reset through episode completion and final metric reads; excludes env construction, Ray/algorithm startup, plotting and file writes
timing.runtime_ms_per_step: 1000 * sum(runtime_sec) / sum(episode_steps), not mean of episode ratios
timing.decision_sec: sum of RL action inference for all drones in a round, or A* planning for all drones in a round
timing.env_step_sec: sum of env.step(...) wall times (excludes env.last and other bookkeeping)
